content: The moth sees the flame and dives in with joyous surrender; the true lover surrenders all petty selfhood in the flame of truth.
author: Kabir
explanation: Spiritual transformation cannot be negotiated halfway. Just as the moth gives itself completely to light, the seeker must willingly let the small ego burn away in the fire of truth.
practicalInsight: Give 100% of your heart to your sacred purpose today without hedging your bets out of fear.
reflectionPrompt: Am I holding back safe reserves, or am I willing to surrender fully to truth?
